title: Volley
html:
Volley is a Hunter ranger weapon action. This ability allows Hunters to attack every enemy in a large area with a ranged weapon rather than a single target.

Description

Fire a cascade of magical broadheads and bodkin arrows upon nearby foes.

Properties

Cost
 Action
Damage
Normal weapon damage
Details
 Ranged Weapon Attack Roll
 Range: Normal weapon range
 AoE: 3 m (10 ft) Radius
 Targets: All non-allied creatures and objects

Technical details

UID
Target_Volley
Spell flags
HasHighGroundRangeExtension, IsHarmful

How to learn

Classes:
  • Class level 11: Hunter

Notes

  • During the beta the description was "Fire a cascade of arrows upon nearby enemies.". In release (Patch #2) the description for this skill was blank and in patch 8 it was finally updated to the current description.
  • This is used essentially in place of a normal ranged attack. It cannot hit party members, but it can hit other friendly NPCs. Otherwise, there is no drawback to using this over a normal ranged attack.
  • Some properties of items are applied to every creature which is hit but some are applied only to a single creature.
    • There does not seem to be a simple rule which creature is affected if only a single creature is affected.
    • It is not obvious which properties apply to every creature and which apply only to a single creature.
    • A list of some useful properties which are applied to every hit enemy:
      •  Amulet of Bhaal: Bleed
      •  Bow of the Banshee: Frightened
      •  Braindrain Gloves: Mental Fatigue
      • All Coatings, excluding: Oil of Diminution (only one creature Reduced, -1 Weapon Enchantment still applies to every roll), Oil of Bane, and all toxins
      •  Encrusted with Frost
      •  Giantbreaker: Reeling
      •  Gloves of Baneful Striking: 1d4 penalty to saving throws
      •  Gloves of Power: Bane
      •  Harold: Bane
      •  Helmet of Arcane Acuity: Arcane Acuity
      •  Radiating Orb
      •  Ring of Spiteful Thunder: Daze
      •  Titanstring Bow: Additional damage
    • A list of some useful properties which are applied only to a single creature:
      • The following Coatings: Oil of Diminution (only one creature Reduced, -1 Weapon Enchantment still applies to every roll), Oil of Bane, and all toxins
      •  Hat of Fire Acuity: Arcane Acuity
      •  Hat of Storm Scion's Power: Arcane Acuity
      •  Reverberation
      •  Snowburst Ring: Ice surface
